metaDescription: UPL Cp 1 cowpea is a cowpea variety from UPLB, Laguna. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: UPL Cp 1 is a registered cowpea variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1976. UPLB, Laguna bred it. It takes about 60 days from sowing to the first harvest, with 1.09 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about UPL Cp 1 cowpea
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

UPL Cp 1 cowpea takes about 60 days from sowing to the first harvest. That is 6.7 days longer than the average of the 13 cowpea varieties with a day count, 53.3 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 1.09 t/ha trails the average of its group, 5.44. It sits in the lower quarter of its group. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

Took some damage but held up

blocks.text: It was weak against rust, so scout for it from the early weeks.

The pests and diseases that hit cowpea fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [bean fly](/pests/bean-fly), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [legume pod borer](/pests/legume-pod-borer). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its pods grew about 12 cm long. The seed coat is red.
Where and when to plant UPL Cp 1 cowpea

Cowpea fits the dry season after rice, on the moisture the paddy keeps. Pick by use: green pods for vegetables, or dry seed. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 60 days from sowing to the first harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 1.09 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of UPL Cp 1?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
